name: LogRocket
description: The LogRocket MCP server lets you query your LogRocket data (session replays, product analytics, and frontend issues) using natural language. Powered by Ask Galileo, it can find and watch specific user sessions, build metrics, and surface the root causes of errors, rage clicks, and UX friction. Connect it to your coding agent to debug user-reported issues, understand how features are used before you change them, triage new errors, and catch regressions after a deploy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LogRocket to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LogRocket to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.logrocket.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LogRocket MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LogRocket provides these MCP tools: build_metric, find_issues, find_sessions, list_organizations, list_projects, use_logrocket, and watch_sessions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LogRocket?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LogRocket in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
LogRocket requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LogRocket is developed by LogRocket Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
